bio: Unwind for one night in a classic room at the charming Cragwood Country House Hotel in Windemere and enjoy a Sparkling Afternoon Tea for two with this gift voucher experience.  Set on the scenic shores of Lake Windemere, Cragwood Country House Hotel is surrounded by beautiful gardens and woodland. Escape to this tranquil setting for a peaceful overnight getaway. Unwind for one night in a classic bedroom and tuck into a delicious Afternoon Tea for two. Savour a selection of scrumptious sweet and savoury nibbles as you sip on a glass of fizz! After a relaxed night's sleep head out to explore the beautiful Lake District.
